facts.fact: GA4 became the default Google Analytics property type after Universal Analytics was retired.
facts.quote: GA4 became the default Google Analytics property type after Universal Analytics was retired

facts.fact: Google recommends turning on Enhanced Measurement for websites.
facts.quote: Google recommends turning this on for websites.

facts.fact: Enhanced Measurement automatically captures common interactions such as page views and other user actions.
facts.quote: It automatically captures common interactions such as page views and other user actions.

facts.fact: Per a WSI guide cited by Adwave, after installing the tag, verify traffic in Realtime using a separate browser or device, and check tag placement, consent settings, and ad blockers if traffic is missing.
facts.quote: Install the tag, then use a separate browser or device to verify traffic in Realtime.

facts.fact: The reporting time zone and currency should be set during account setup because wrong settings cause reporting and sales-value mismatches.
facts.quote: Set the reporting time zone and currency

facts.fact: The GA4 tag should be placed site-wide, since a tag on only some pages creates holes in reporting.
facts.quote: A tag on only some pages creates holes in your reporting.

facts.fact: Adwave states that it can place ads across more than 100 premium channels, including NBC, Hulu, and ESPN.
facts.quote: can place ads across **100+ premium channels including NBC, Hulu, and ESPN**

facts.fact: According to Adwave's company information, Adwave campaigns start at $30 per day.
facts.quote: with campaigns starting at **$30/day**, according to Adwave's company information

facts.fact: GA4 allows users to mark important events as conversions.
facts.quote: GA4 lets you mark important events as conversions.
